issue.body:
## Summary

- Adds `test/benchmarkUtils.ts`, a shared helper (`writeBenchmark` / `recordBenchmarkSample`) that writes a `[{name, unit: 'ms', value}]` benchmark.json, and computes a running mean across samples for suites with multiple scenarios/fixtures.
- **system**: `test/system/diagram.spec.ts` already timestamps `rebuilding -> firstGraph`; now also writes `test-results/system/artifacts/benchmark.json` (`system-diagram-generation-duration`).
- **bdd**: `BddWorld._waitForDiagramRebuild()` now timestamps busy-indicator-visible -> busy-indicator-hidden+node-present and records each sample to `test-results/bdd/artifacts/benchmark.json` (`bdd-diagram-generation-duration`), covering every scenario that rebuilds/opens the diagram.
- **visual**: `postView()` timestamps the post-message, `openFixture()` resolves the duration once the ready selector attaches, and `expectGraphAndScreenshot()` flushes it to `test-results/visual/artifacts/benchmark.json` (`visual-diagram-generation-duration`) before the snapshot assertion.
- CI: adds a `benchmark-action/github-action-benchmark@v1.22.1` step to `test_system`, `test_bdd`, and `test_visual`, all pointed at a shared `gh-pages` branch / `dev/bench` data dir with distinct `name`s so each suite renders as its own chart. `auto-push` only runs on `push` (not PRs, to avoid failing on fork-token permissions); `comment-on-alert: true`; `fail-on-alert: false` until a baseline settles. `test_system` is a matrix over vscode versions — only the newest version's job reports a sample, so gh-pages doesn't get 3x duplicate points per run.

Closes #116

## Test plan

- [x] `npm run lint` (tsc across extension/webview/cli configs) — clean
- [x] `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` — no new errors vs. master baseline (pre-existing unrelated errors in test/unit, test/bdd, etc. are unchanged)
- [x] Standalone smoke test of `writeBenchmark`/`recordBenchmarkSample` (mean calc, negative-duration guard) — caught and fixed a real bug where `Number('')` from a trailing blank line was silently counted as a zero sample
- [ ] Full `test:system` / `test:bdd` / `test:visual` runs (require a built Surelog/UHDM backend + VS Code + Xvfb; not exercised in this environment) — will be validated by CI on this PR


<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added automated tracking of diagram-generation performance across visual, BDD, and system tests.
  * Published benchmark results for monitoring performance trends over time.

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Improved benchmark accuracy by ignoring invalid measurements and aggregating valid samples.
  * Improved rendering readiness checks by validating diagram dimensions before completion.

* **Chores**
  * Updated CI workflows to collect and publish performance benchmarks automatically.
  * Added release metadata for the performance benchmark improvements.
